title: Trainstorm Element (Occurrence)
description: One OCCURRENCE of an atom in a course — not a rival meaning canon. atom_id is the meaning-node key (locale packs join there); element_id (ele_) is minted at realization and keys this placement. composed_from is the required link to that atom. The element never carries authored meaning of its own; occurrence facets (rhetorical, move, teaches, intended_response, expression keys) bind here. Containers (Course/Module/Section/Scene) and leaf elements (Head/Statement/…) are both occurrence nodes, related by structure.parent_id. One agent owns each facet (single-writer).

element_id.description: Occurrence key (prefix ele_), minted at realization. Addressable identity of THIS placement of an atom in a course — the same atom may be a hook in module 1 and reinforce in module 5. Not the join key for locale packs (those key on atom_id via composed_from). Never reused or edited.

composed_from.description: The atom_id this occurrence realizes. Required explicit link under 1:many (architecture/DECISIONS.md 2026-08-25 occurrence identity). Meaning and content_hash live on that atom; this node does not duplicate them.

source_hash.description: Optional stale-detection handle. Meaning-change detection is the atom's content_hash, joined through composed_from. Locale packs key on atom_id, not this field. If present, typically echoes the atom's content_hash so an occurrence can be flagged when its atom's meaning moved.

type.description: What this occurrence IS. Containers and leaf elements share the array; parent/child is expressed via structure.parent_id.

content.description: NOT the meaning store. Meaning lives on the atom (composed_from). Authored text on the occurrence is a known 1:many violation (decision-log 2026-08-20 eighth; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-25). Default: omit this field. Optional only as a presentation-constraint copy (length limits, heading vs sentence) — never as source meaning, never as the locale-pack join. Locale packs key on atom_id.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag of a presentation-constraint copy, if one exists. Not the source-meaning locale — that is meaning.source_locale on the atom.

text.description: Presentation-constraint copy only (e.g. a shortened heading). Not canonical source meaning. Prefer omit.

structure.description: Object facet — this occurrence's place in the course graph. Owner: Content Architecture.

intent.description: Occurrence-level intent — ALL of it. Owner: L&D / Instructional Design. `rhetorical` = what this does on the page; `move` = what teaching act it performs HERE; `teaches` + `intended_response` live here (not on the atom) because objectives are intervention-scoped (2026-08-21 Fable-run restitch, landed 2026-08-25). `bloom` lives on the objective node.

rhetorical.description: What the element does on the page (from scene.schema). A lint rule may default this from `type` (e.g. Head→orient) — not enforced here so reuse stays legal.

teaches.description: objective_ids in the intent ontology this OCCURRENCE serves. Intervention-scoped: the same atom may teach different objectives at different placements. Moved off the atom 2026-08-21.

intended_response.description: The cognitive/affective response this occurrence is designed to elicit. Moved off the atom 2026-08-21.

move.description: The teaching MOVE this occurrence performs — what instructional act is happening here. MIRRORS vocab/intent.enum.json dimensions.pedagogical (Gagné's events, retention and transfer split); the vocab is canonical and the mirror is checked by tools/validate_objectives.py. Occurrence-level, and a sibling of `rhetorical`: both answer 'what is this doing HERE'. The same atom is a `hook` in module 1 and `reinforce` in module 5 — that is spaced repetition, and it is why move cannot live on the atom. Distinct from teaches[]: a move is the MEANS, an objective the END, and many moves serve one objective. The names are a closed list on purpose — an open one would destroy the coverage queries ('does this module contain any retrieval practice?', 'does every objective have an assess move?') that are the whole reason for having the dimension. The REALISATION of a move is unbounded. See decision log 2026-08-21.

expression.description: Form — KEYS into the expression registries (from scene.schema's primitive refs). Never embedded styles or translations. Owner: Brand + Localization. Occurrence-level: the same atom may be a heading here and a body line there.

content_role.description: Finer role of this element within its primitive (from course-primitives).

audience.description: Fit hooks for the responsive engine (the manifold add). Design-time targeting + adaptivity metadata; holds NO learner PII — that lives in the separate learner model. Owner: L&D Adaptivity.

variant_group.description: Group of interchangeable variants; the engine picks one per learner.

assessment.description: Assessment facet (from course-primitives.relationships). Present on interactive/assessment nodes.

narration.description: Voice facet (from scene.narration + course-primitives.speaker). Owner: Narration/Audio. Spoken variant of on-screen text is occurrence-level delivery, not a second meaning store.

voice_text.description: Spoken variant of the on-screen text (resolved from the atom's meaning unless presentation constrains it), source locale.

render.description: Render-target facet — inputs to the render agents (from scene.render + course-primitives.render). Downstream of expression.

governance.description: Provenance/authority — per occurrence. Owner: Governance / Quality.

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point. New/experimental facets go here so they can accrete without a breaking schema change; promote to a first-class facet once stable.
